algorithm: Sort providers by price, skip insufficient context windows, then retry connection failures. Guardrails precede quotas and provider calls. Single-flight keyed locks serialize duplicate prompts. Selection is O(P log P).
architecture: HTTP workload API → synchronous run harness → asyncio gateway → guardrail/quota → tenant-scoped cache → provider abstraction.
data_model: Inputs are prompt strings and tenant IDs. Outputs carry status, selected provider, estimated tokens and synthetic cost units. Workload metrics reconcile every request.
description: An asynchronous local routing gateway with context-aware provider selection, single-flight caching and admission quotas.
design: Mocks make cost and failure decisions reproducible. Prices are arbitrary units, not actual vendor fees. A provider failure is distinct from a policy block. Lock lifetime is bounded by the short-lived experiment, not a persistent gateway.
family_notes: Route short prompts to the cheapest fitting provider.
Long prompts exceed the economy context and need a larger provider.
Mix context lengths while preserving request accounting.
Block explicit instruction-override patterns before provider execution.
Admit only the configured tenant request quota.
Fall back when the economy provider is unavailable.
limitations: Providers are deterministic mocks; no external LLM, Redis or ONNX model is bundled. Pattern matching is a demonstration and cannot reliably detect jailbreaks. Character-based token estimates differ from real tokenizers. Distributed shared quotas, streaming completions, cache size in bytes and credential management remain extension work.
operations: Run the loopback dashboard locally. In a production adapter use TLS, real tokenizer limits, deadline propagation, a shared quota backend and audited safety policies.
scope: Asyncio provider abstraction, approximate token budgeting, cheapest eligible routing, tenant quotas, in-memory TTL/LRU cache, synthetic provider fallback and a local workload HTTP API.
security: Treat this as educational code; review it before handling trusted data.
title: Distributed LLM Inference Router & Guardrail Engine
